diagnostic_limit: Previous UI did not retain the underlying JavaScript or request error, so the exact cause of this occurrence cannot be proven retrospectively.
code_issue_found: Running state was published before the worker set trial and preparation phase; UI assumed any running state had a valid phase and could throw and abort.
fix: Initialize trial and preparation synchronously under lock before publishing running; guard transitional state; classify/log client errors; unavailable speech does not abort.
capture_and_firmware: No firmware, MIDI or Ableton changes; live sensor capture continues.
